text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (June 19, 2025) for 94 Clansman Boulevard.

The Property Standards Committee – North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (June 19, 2025) for 94 Clansman Boulevard, Folder Number 25 180068 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to December 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
